name: Windswept Farm Summer Riding Camp
description_short: A horse boarding and riding lesson farm in Warren, RI, with indoor and outdoor arenas. In the summer it runs weekly riding camps for all experience levels, with daily riding lessons plus unmounted horse-care activities.
